stem: In the late 1800s, which action taken by American workers was MOST successful in addressing the problems described in this excerpt?

options.label: A
options.text: Seizing the means of production from business owners

options.label: B
options.text: Joining the organized labor union movement

options.label: C
options.text: Organizing investigations into the use of child labor

options.label: D
options.text: Protesting to force the government to eliminate tariffs

visual_elements: I work harder now than when my pay was twice as large. Less than five years ago wages were from $12 to $18 a week currency; now they are from $6 to $12, and work not as steady. . . . During working hours the men are not allowed to speak to each other, though working close together, on pain of instant discharge. Men are hired to watch and patrol the shop. —Massachusetts Bureau of Statistics of Labor, 1879
